title: Reinventing in-home senior care for a US digital health platform 34
excerpt: A US-based digital health platform revolutionizing elder care by connecting families with trusted, background-checked in-home caregivers, Procyon delivered the Salesforce + MuleSoft + web & mobile stack behind it.
challenge: Families struggled to find trusted, background-checked in-home caregivers for elderly relatives.
Traditional senior care models were expensive and opaque, with limited flexibility for families and caregivers.
Caregiver onboarding, scheduling and family communication were fragmented across multiple disconnected tools.

approach.title: Salesforce core
approach.detail: Built the platform of record for caregivers, families and care plans on Salesforce, with workflows for vetting, onboarding and matching.

approach.title: MuleSoft integration
approach.detail: Integrated background-check, payments and scheduling systems through a MuleSoft API layer so every channel speaks the same language.

approach.title: Web & mobile experiences
approach.detail: Delivered consumer-grade web and mobile apps for families and caregivers, with transparent pricing and flexible-hours scheduling.

approach.title: Operational visibility
approach.detail: Stood up dashboards giving the operations team a single view of demand, caregiver utilization and family satisfaction across all states.

results: Enabled 50% savings over traditional care models.
Increased caregiver satisfaction through transparent pay and flexible hours.
Improved family trust and engagement with a secure, all-in-one management platform.
Helped 1,500+ families access quality senior care with minimal friction.

title: Genesys: modernizing global partner onboarding on Salesforce
excerpt: Genesys, a global leader in cloud-based customer experience and contact center solutions, engaged Procyon Technostructure to modernize its Salesforce environment and transform partner onboarding for internal users and external partners.
challenge: The existing Salesforce partner onboarding flow was dated, manual, and inconsistent across regions.
Internal users and external partners lacked a collaborative, intuitive workspace for joint deals and enablement.
Reporting on partner engagement and pipeline health was limited and not real-time.

approach.title: Process re-imagination
approach.detail: Re-imagined the end-to-end partner onboarding journey with automation and streamlined approvals.

approach.title: Lightning migration
approach.detail: Modernized the Salesforce experience on the Lightning UI for both internal users and external partners.

approach.title: Self-service & collaboration
approach.detail: Introduced self-service tools and real-time collaboration capabilities for partners across the global network.

approach.title: Operational insight
approach.detail: Built data-driven dashboards and KPIs to give leadership visibility into partner activity and pipeline.

results: 30%+ faster partner onboarding through automation and streamlined workflows.
Higher user satisfaction with a modern Lightning interface.
Enhanced partner engagement via self-service tools and real-time collaboration.
Improved operational visibility with data-driven dashboards and KPIs.
Secure, scalable foundation supporting Genesys's expanding global partner network.

title: Salesforce Service Cloud replaces Siebel at a $5B 3D software leader
excerpt: A leading industry leader in 3D and animation software for architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing and M&E, with $5B in annual revenue, replaced its Siebel Service Request call-centre application with Salesforce Service Cloud.
challenge: The client was using a Siebel Service Request call-centre application that was costly to maintain and slow to evolve.
Service agents lacked a modern, unified workspace and 360° view of the customer.
The business needed a scalable foundation aligned with the global Salesforce roadmap.

approach.title: Service Cloud blueprint
approach.detail: Designed a Service Cloud target state mapped to existing Siebel SR processes, with a clean re-cut where it made sense.

approach.title: Agent experience
approach.detail: Reimagined the call-centre agent console for faster case capture, routing and resolution.

approach.title: Data & telephony
approach.detail: Migrated service request data and integrated telephony and core systems into the Salesforce platform.

approach.title: Global rollout
approach.detail: Coordinated a phased global cutover with adoption support for the contact-centre organization.

results: Successfully replaced the legacy Siebel call-centre application with Salesforce Service Cloud.
Modernized the agent experience and case-handling workflows.
Established a scalable, upgrade-safe foundation aligned with the customer's global Salesforce strategy.

title: Consolidating 38 CRMs into one Salesforce Service Cloud for 5,000+ agents
client: Global Security, Storage & Systems Management Leader
excerpt: A global provider of security, storage, and systems management solutions with over $5B in revenue rolled out Salesforce.com Service Cloud as the single enterprise customer-service application for over 5,000 agents and vendors worldwide.
challenge: The CRM landscape included over 38 enterprise home-grown and vendor systems.
Decentralized processes made it impossible to give agents a single view of the customer.
Inbound and outbound calling required CTI integration across a fragmented estate.

approach.title: Single global CRM
approach.detail: Standardized on Salesforce Service Cloud as the enterprise customer-service application for the entire global organization.

approach.title: Process unification
approach.detail: Re-engineered decentralized service processes into a single global model, with regional variation only where regulation required it.

approach.title: CTI integration
approach.detail: Integrated computer telephony for inbound and outbound calling so agents could work end-to-end from the Salesforce console.

approach.title: Reporting & insights
approach.detail: Built enhanced reporting capabilities for service operations leadership to manage the global agent and vendor network.

results: All customer service agents across the globe were brought onto one CRM system, increasing visibility, marketability and enabling efficient up-selling and cross-selling.
Enhanced reporting capabilities for global service operations.
Global rollout of Salesforce Service Cloud as the enterprise customer-service application for over 5,000 agents and vendors.

title: Fund and claims management on Salesforce for a $4.5B peripherals manufacturer
excerpt: A leading computer peripherals manufacturer with ~$4.5B in annual revenue had no fund-tracking system for promotions and campaigns. Procyon built a custom Salesforce-based platform to create projects and activities, allocate funds through multi-step approvals, and automate claim processing.
challenge: Business had no fund-tracking system for promotions and campaigning.
Sales and marketing users needed to create projects and activities and assign funds routed through multiple approvals.
Claim processing was heavily manual, with intervention required across the workflow.

approach.title: Custom project & fund app
approach.detail: Built a custom Salesforce interface to create projects and activities and assign funds, with dynamic approvals and fund-availability checking.

approach.title: Claims automation
approach.detail: Automated claim processing end-to-end and synchronized data with Oracle systems for accrual management.

approach.title: Finance + commercial alignment
approach.detail: Gave finance users the ability to create funds and trace utilization, and enabled sales and marketing to allocate funds to specific activities.

approach.title: Open & integrated system
approach.detail: Delivered an open system to manage funds for promotion and campaigning activities, claims and accruals across the enterprise.

results: Fund data visibility across the enterprise.
Finance users can create funds and trace fund utilization.
Sales and marketing users can create projects and activities with allocated funds.
Open system to manage funds on promotion and campaigning activities, with claims processing integrated to Oracle for accrual processing.
